sequence.description: Enable application tag restriction, login as a non-admin user without the tag, then attempt to obtain a usable token via token exchange to bypass the tag gate.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Application-level authorization gates (tags) must constrain effective permissions; token exchange must not bypass sign-in restrictions and mint a valid session for a user who is not allowed to access the application.
